name: Synn
message: 「This is bad, there's no end to them at this rate」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We'll hold them off here, so Synn, you go after Senpai!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm pretty sure she ran off this way... Ah!」
I found someone collapsed on the ground.
No external injuries, and no signs of her having been messed with either. She's just passed out, and she's still breathing.
I looked around restlessly. Just then, I spotted a panda plushie lying right next to her.

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Making the great me cum just by being next to you. Expect nothing less from you, Ria-chan... Fwaaah!」
Did Ria-senpai's pheromones knock him out? Well, I can't say I blame him.

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, you drank way too much!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Losing control of myself like that, how pathetic. Uugh, my head's killing me」
Well anyway, it looks like he's back to normal.
Ria-senpai suddenly clung to me, trembling.

name: Ria
message: 「I suddenly blacked out, and I don't remember anything after that, I...」
So even someone like Ria-senpai can get scared like this.

name: Synn
message: 「It's okay, Ria-senpai. You don't have to be scared anymore」
Realizing the situation, she finally pulled away.
Seeing Ria-senpai all flustered makes me smile, contrasting with her usual dignified demeanor.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I was just thinking that even Ria-senpai has things she's scared of」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I wasn't scared at all! I was just a liiittle surprised, that's all\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, you know, I'm a girl too. Acting like I'm not afraid of anything is super rude!」
Today of all days, there's no room for sympathy.

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine, really. It's not like anything was done to him」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh!? I-I couldn't possibly say it out loud...」
Back to her usual self, Ria-senpai immediately has me wrapped around her finger.
I really am no match for Ria-senpai after all.

name: Ria
message: 「Paa-chan... You're usually a bit more gentlemanly, so why would you drink alcohol...」

name: Synn
message: 「I doubt Paqy would drink on his own, and he can't even buy alcohol in the first place.」

name: Ria
message: 「I wonder if someone forced him to drink it~」

name: Synn
message: 「Speaking of people who would push alcohol onto Paqy--」
I hadn't even said who it was yet, and her little sister sure puts her through a lot.

name: Synn
message: 「You guys beat yours too, huh. Anyone hurt?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It was merely a clone of Mr. Panda, after all. Hardly a match for us. An effortless V, yes it is!」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone... thank you. I'm sorry for making you worry.」

name: Synn
message: 「As long as you're safe, Senpai, that's all that matters. Right, everyone?」

name: Misa
message: 「If anything had happened to her, you wouldn't have gotten away with it!!」

name: Ria
message: 「She got flattened like a paper-thin rice cracker... Ahaha\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, Senpai's open-air classroom worked like a charm right away, yes it did.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I feel like I was able to bring out more of my strength than usual.」

name: Misa
message: 「This is all thanks to you, Onee-sama.」

name: Ria
message: 「I see. Everyone's really getting stronger, huh. I'm glad\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, since we finished a job, how about some tea?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「All right! I've been waiting for this!」

name: Misa
message: 「Onee―sama. Today, I will make the black tea―」

name: Ria
message: 「No, no. Let me treat you all today.」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like you're always treating us...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa just doesn't want to drink Japanese tea because it's bitter, right? Jeez, what a kid.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You just need to put sugar in it♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn. Make sure you take that fishcake over there home with you.」
I pick up the scrapped Paqy and whisper to him.

name: Synn
message: 「If you keep doing weird stuff all the time, Ria-senpai's gonna end up hating you.」
Well, we managed to cover up the fact that he's a demon this time, so it'll probably be fine.
Saying that, what she held out was a personal stamp.

name: Ria
message: 「As thanks for helping me out, okay?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's a special bonus. Keep it a secret from everyone\s04」
Though honestly, I've never even seen anyone besides me getting stamped in the first place.

name: Ria
message: 「Keep at it until it's completely full, okay?\s07」
By the time all the stamps are filled in, I wonder if I'll have become like Senpai too.
